cohort: 12 women with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treated with thiopurine and allopurinol co-therapy before conception and for the duration of pregnancy
finding: No adverse pregnancy outcomes attributable to thiopurine and allopurinol co-therapy were detected in this case series of women with IBD.
mod_finding: Of the 14 live births, 7 were vaginal deliveries and 6 were Caesarean sections.
